entries.reason: Vellum's renderer-independent damage model for its retained scene. Pulp has no damage regions or tracker.
Cross-frame paragraph, gradient and mesh-texture caches and their telemetry, owned by Vellum's surface. Pulp has neither.
The retained path node's geometry, parser and budgets. Pulp's ScenePath (VectorScene, SVG import) is a separate API.
Diagnostics for what Vellum's scene lowering drops. Pulp has no scene lowering.
Vellum's authoring materializer from the JS rendered tree to its retained scene. Pulp has no materializer.
Test harness for Vellum's offscreen scene captures. Pulp keeps its own visual harness.
Tests and benchmark for the retained surface's incremental presentation, which exists only in Vellum.
Vellum's own CMake lists. A change to them adds or wires Vellum targets; Pulp's build is separate and is never ported from them.

policy: An observation whose every mapped and transitive path is listed here, with no schema or API delta, not security or P0, and nothing under framework/, is resolved framework-only by reconcile with owner auto:vellum-native-paths@<entry ids>. Each entry's absent_in_pulp symbols are checked against Pulp at the observatory cursor; an entry whose symbol appears there is stale and fails verify. Adding or widening an entry is a release-path change (CODEOWNERS, two reviews). Any later resolution overrides an automatic one.
